claim: For either 16-point minimal finite model \(K_{1,0}\) or \(K_{0,1}\) of the Klein bottle, the \(7{,}678{,}760\) continuous self-maps induce exactly ten endomorphisms of \(H_1(K;\mathbb Z)\cong\mathbb Z\oplus\mathbb Z/2\). Writing \(t\) for the order-two class and \(x\) for a free generator, every induced map has \(t\mapsto\delta t\) and \(x\mapsto kx+\varepsilon t\), where \(k\in\{-1,0,1\}\), \(\varepsilon\in\mathbb Z/2\), and \(\delta=0\) when \(k=0\) while \(\delta\in\mathbb Z/2\) is arbitrary when \(k=\pm1\). Exactly 16 self-maps induce homology isomorphisms, and these are precisely the 16 homeomorphisms. Compared with the classical Klein bottle, whose self-maps realize the same parity pattern for arbitrary integer \(k\), the cardinality-minimal finite models truncate the free homology multiplier to \(-1,0,1\).

title: Homology-action truncation in the minimal finite Klein-bottle models
